newsitem.title: USA: Motorola selected to make model CDMA phone.
newsitem.headline: Motorola selected to make model CDMA phone.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Friday it was selected by NTT Mobile Communications Network Inc to develop a prototype cellular telephone for its upcoming digital system in Japan.
NTT, the cellular affiliate of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, is expected to commercially offer Wide-band Code Division Multiple Access (W-CDMA) service in Japan in 2000, Motorola said.
The wireless telecommunications system would provide increased data transmission speed and system capacity, and allow for video transmission.
Motorola is one of various companies chosen to build a prototype phone, the company said.
Motorola provides wireless communications, semiconductors and advanced electronic systems, components and services.
